text_en: Find someone who knows the year the Grapevine began
text_es: Encuentra a alguien que sepa en qué año empezó el Grapevine
short_es: El año en que empezó Grapevine
notes: Answer: 1944 (first issue June 1944). booth quiz-gvhist-founders.

text_en: How many AA members started the Grapevine? Find someone who knows
text_es: ¿Cuántos miembros de AA fundaron el Grapevine? Busca a quien sepa
notes: Answer: six (four women and two men, New York area, 1944). booth quiz-gvhist-founders, fill-gvhist-founders.

text_en: Who first called the Grapevine their “meeting in print”? Ask around
text_es: ¿Quiénes llamaron primero al Grapevine su «reunión impresa»? Pregunta por ahí
notes: Answer: AA members serving in the armed forces (the Mail Call page). booth quiz-gvhist-meeting-in-print.

text_en: Ask someone why the magazine is called “Grapevine”
text_es: Pregúntale a alguien por qué la revista se llama «Grapevine»
notes: Answer: news passed along informally, “through the grapevine”. booth fact-fun-grapevine-name.

text_en: What did Bill W. first set out in the April 1946 Grapevine? Ask around
text_es: ¿Qué presentó Bill W. por primera vez en el Grapevine de abril de 1946? Pregunta por ahí
notes: Answer: the points that became the Twelve Traditions. booth quiz-gvhist-traditions.

text_en: In which year did Grapevine first print the AA Preamble? Find someone who knows
short_en: The Preamble in GV: what year?
text_es: ¿En qué año publicó el Grapevine por primera vez el Preámbulo de AA? Busca a quien sepa
notes: Answer: 1947 (the June 1947 issue; the Preamble was written by a Grapevine editor). It asks for the year: read-preamble names the Preamble. booth quiz-gvhist-preamble-author, history-gvhist-1947-preamble.

text_en: Why has the Grapevine had no staples since 2009? Find someone who knows
text_es: ¿Por qué el Grapevine no lleva grapas desde 2009? Busca a quien sepa
notes: Answer: so it can go into prisons that don't allow staples (March 2009). booth quiz-gvhist-staple-free. Reason: GVR Handbook 2024, p. 7 (the evolution page gives only the date).

text_en: Since which year has the Serenity Prayer appeared regularly in Grapevine? Ask around
text_es: ¿Desde qué año sale con regularidad la Oración de la Serenidad en Grapevine? Averígualo
short_es: La Oración en GV: ¿desde qué año?
notes: Answer: 1967 (since July 1967; the early issues had already helped it spread throughout AA). booth fact-gvhist-serenity-prayer.

text_en: “The Man on the Bed” first appeared in the Grapevine. Who knows the year?
short_en: “The Man on the Bed”: which year?
text_es: «The Man on the Bed» salió primero en el Grapevine. ¿Quién sabe el año?
notes: Answer: 1955 (the December 1955 issue). booth fact-gvhist-man-on-bed.

text_en: The Language of the Heart gathers Bill W.'s Grapevine writings. What year did it come out?
short_en: Language of the Heart: what year?
text_es: El lenguaje del corazón reúne los escritos de Bill W. para el Grapevine. ¿De qué año es?
notes: Answer: 1988 (gathered in one book; published in three languages). booth quiz-gvhist-language-heart. Spanish title as in data/site/shop.json.

text_en: Grapevine's At Wit's End page shares its name with Bill W.'s ___ at Stepping Stones
text_es: La página At Wit's End de Grapevine se llama como el ___ de Bill W. en Stepping Stones
short_es: At Wit's End: el ___ de Bill W.
notes: Answer: his study, at Stepping Stones (his writing studio counts too; the name first appeared in April 2007; readers suggested it). booth quiz-gvhist-wits-end.

text_en: Find someone who knows the year La Viña's first issue came out
text_es: Encuentra a alguien que sepa en qué año salió el primer número de La Viña
short_es: El año en que empezó La Viña
notes: Answer: 1996 (never a month: the sources differ). booth quiz-lv-first-issue.

text_en: How many issues of La Viña come out each year? Ask around
text_es: ¿Cuántos números de La Viña salen cada año? Pregunta por ahí
notes: Answer: six (every two months). booth quiz-lv-how-often.

text_en: What name was first thought of for La Viña? Find someone who knows
text_es: ¿Qué nombre se pensó primero para La Viña? Busca a quien sepa
notes: Answer: El Grapevine. booth quiz-lv-first-name.

text_en: Find someone who can tell you what “La Viña” means in English
text_es: Encuentra a alguien que sepa qué significa «La Viña» en inglés
notes: Answer: vineyard, where grapes grow. booth scramble-lv-vineyard, quiz-lv-first-name.

text_en: In which month does La Viña celebrate its anniversary? Ask around
text_es: ¿En qué mes celebra La Viña su aniversario? Pregunta por ahí
notes: Answer: July. booth truefalse-lv-anniversary-july.

text_en: Before La Viña, which English-language AA magazine ran articles in Spanish?
text_es: Antes de La Viña, ¿qué revista de AA en inglés publicaba artículos en español?
notes: Answer: Grapevine (September 1991 to June 1996). booth fact-fun-before-la-vina. 'English-language' narrows it: local Spanish-language AA bulletins and magazines existed too (history-aa-lavina).

text_en: In 1962, the Conference asked retiring delegates to become… what?
text_es: En 1962, la Conferencia pidió a los delegados salientes que fueran… ¿qué?
notes: Answer: Grapevine representatives (GVRs). booth quiz-service-1962-action.

text_en: In 1954, before GVRs, each group was encouraged to name a Grapevine… what?
text_es: En 1954, antes de los GVR, se animó a cada grupo a nombrar a un… ¿qué de Grapevine?
notes: Answer: a Grapevine reporter. booth fact-service-1954-reporter.

text_en: In which year did the Conference recommend a Grapevine table at all assemblies?
short_en: GV table at assemblies: what year?
text_es: ¿En qué año recomendó la Conferencia una mesa de Grapevine en todas las asambleas?
notes: Answer: 1978 (a Grapevine information table at all conferences, conventions and assemblies; M-39 p. 53). booth truefalse-service-1978-table. Not 1959: that action asked for displays at conferences and conventions.

text_en: In 1986, how did the Conference recognize AA Grapevine? Find someone who knows
text_es: En 1986, ¿cómo reconoció la Conferencia a AA Grapevine? Busca a quien sepa
notes: Answer: as the international journal of AA, a recognition that extends to La Viña. booth history-gvhist-1986-recognition. Recognized, never 'approved'.

text_en: In what year did the Grapevine and La Viña apps arrive?
text_es: ¿En qué año llegaron las aplicaciones de La Viña y Grapevine?
notes: Answer: 2023. booth quiz-lv-apps-year.

text_en: La Viña's very first issue reached subscribers far and wide. Name one place
short_en: Where La Viña's first issue went
text_es: El primer número de La Viña llegó a suscriptores de muchos lugares. Nombra uno
notes: Answer: the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Central and South America, the Caribbean, Europe. booth quiz-lv-first-subscribers.
